about: Every model / data file Onset needs, where it comes from, and its checksum. scripts/fetch_models.py fills MODELS_DIR (default ~/Library/Application Support/<APP_NAME>/models) from this; server/modelpaths.py resolves paths by 'dir'.

models.name: Arc Mini (the streaming ear: words with times, revisions, command_complete; also Arc metadata under Flux and recordings), run by libarc in C

source.note: Gated repo (accept the Arc licence on Hugging Face; set HF_TOKEN to fetch). Files are the repo's mini/ folder plus its LICENSE and NOTICE.

models.revision: v1.2.0 (WhissleAI/arc-v1.1 tag; mini/ = the v1.1.1 weights), 4-bit weights read by libarc 1.5.0 (vendor/arc)
models.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 + Whissle terms (Arc weights, LICENSE); bundled Moonshine Streaming tiny (modified): MIT (moonshine-streaming-tiny/LICENSE); see NOTICE
models.note: Default ear since ARC_BACKEND=mini (MACAPP.md 'Arc Mini in C'). No torch: loaded by server/arc_c.py through libarc.dylib.

models.name: Arc n-gram LM (spoken questions; fused into Arc Mini's decoder for finals, libarc arc_set_lm)

source.note: Built by WhissleAI/PromptingNemo-private recipes/arc/ngram_lm (build_lm.py @4ad1639 --order 3 --prune 0,8,16; corpus: corpora/questions/prep_*.py, weighted by mix.py; Onset's eval texts excluded). Release copy: manifest.release.json. Without it the ear runs exactly as before (no LM).

models.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (n-gram statistics of CC BY-SA / CC BY / Apache-2.0 / MIT question corpora; NOTICE lists them)
models.note: Loaded by server/ear.py via config.arc_lm(): ARC_LM=0 turns it off, ARC_LM_WEIGHT (0.3), ARC_LM_PARTIALS (0: partials and the endpoint untouched). MACAPP.md 'Arc n-gram LM' has the A/B.

models.name: Arc v1 (the old ear: arc_audio 1.0.1 on torch; only with ARC_BACKEND=v1)

source.note: No public source: https://huggingface.co/WhissleAI/arc-v1 (named in its README) is not reachable anonymously. The public successor WhissleAI/arc-v1.1 (gated: accept terms) ships a different package + q4 weights and is not a drop-in for server/ear.py. Import a copy: fetch_models.py import arc-v1=PATH.

models.revision: f0e43f48eee72070d18ddd2bd207df4624e85028 (arc-audio 1.0.1; HF commit recorded in the copy's .cache/huggingface)
models.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Arc code + weights); bundled Moonshine Streaming tiny: MIT (see NOTICE)

models.name: Arc Tagger (10M text tagger, int8 ONNX weights read by libarctag)
models.revision: Hub main 5004492 (2026-11-17): the v0.4.1 int8 weights, tokenizer and meta unchanged; the commit adds onnx/arctag_kids.json (kids / game thresholds, not used by OnSet: libarctag 0.5.0 has the same table built in). A local v0.3.0 copy is accepted too ('also').
models.note: Runtime: vendor/arctag = arc-tagger-c 0.5.0 (main d2c3e4d, 2026-11-23: kids / game profile + guard layer, off unless the kids profile is chosen; same native int8 kernels as 0.4.1).

also.note: v0.3.0 (the release this repo's tests were written against; not on the Hub any more)

models.name: EmbeddingGemma 2 (740M; text + audio embeddings, reranker, local index)
EmbeddingGemma 2, ONNX (text + audio towers, 8-bit weights; used instead of embeddinggemma-2 when ONNX_RUNTIME=1)

source.note: Built from embeddinggemma-2 (rev f9972ac) by scripts/native/export_embed.py + scripts/native/quantize_embed.py (MACAPP.md 'Native runtime'); the release copy is on Dropbox (manifest.release.json). Import a local copy: fetch_models.py import embeddinggemma-2-onnx=PATH.

models.license: Apache 2.0 (EmbeddingGemma 2 model card; modified: see NOTICE). Gemma Prohibited Use Policy applies to deployments.
